# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and GTK4 rendering** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 alongside GPU-backed GTK4 views. Linux NoDependencies packages regain system-font discovery, and WebAssembly assets align with .NET 11. GTK4 high-density painting and Tizen support have new requirements; review the migration guidance before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **GTK4 raster painting defaults to physical pixels** — SKDrawingArea now allocates high-density backing storage and reports physical pixels through CanvasSize and paint Info by default. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical painting coordinates; RawInfo still describes physical pixels, and GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Tizen packages require Tizen 10** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and no longer support Tizen 8 or 9. Retarget applications to Tizen 10 and .NET 10; source builders need the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2 for x64 or arm64. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 156** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m156 without adding managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.100 while the native HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU canvas** — SKGLArea adds PaintSurface, a view-owned GRContext, optional continuous rendering and pixel-scaling control using GTK's GL context. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy, which dispatches GL calls for the active context. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery restored** — Finds installed fonts through the directory-backed default manager without requiring fontconfig. The default search root is /usr/share/fonts/, restoring family lookup and avoiding SKShaper failures caused by empty typefaces when fonts are installed. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Matching WebAssembly assets for .NET 11** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for net11 and later, including threading and SIMD variants. .NET 8 retains 3.1.34 assets, while .NET 9 and 10 retain 3.1.56. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp selects Emscripten 6.0.2 assets for .NET 11 and later and raises its Tizen packages to net10.0-tizen10.0. Windows native builds also align their selected compiler and Spectre CRT versions.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, native GTK4 GPU rendering and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. It aligns WebAssembly assets with .NET 11 and raises Tizen packages to Tizen 10.
